title: Small satin text at 5 mm sews about as many stitches as PE-DESIGN's S fonts
description: abc ijt in Lato Bold satin at 5 mm, against the numbers recorded from PE-DESIGN 11.50's Small Text font 01 Utah Bold S at 5.0 mm (round 8, #530; its smallest size, 4 mm being refused). PE-DESIGN's file is a Brother font's output, so it stays in the owner's notes and never in the repository: only its recorded numbers are used here, as expected values (internal-regression tier, not reference). Compared: the stitch count within 25 % (as the stroke-satin specs against PE-DESIGN's own Lato Bold references) and the height. Not compared, and recorded only: the 23.4 mm width belongs to PE-DESIGN's wider Utah Bold (Lato Bold is 18.9 mm), and its trims (about 6) depend on the font's letter shapes.

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 Small Text, font 01 Utah Bold S, 5.0 mm, abc ijt: 23.4 x 6.4 mm, 336 stitches, satin at density 4.5, about 6 trims (coordinator's round-8 capture, numbers on #530; the file is not in the repository)

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN's Utah Bold S at 5.0 mm sews abc ijt in 336 stitches (round 8, #530)
PE-DESIGN's abc ijt at 5.0 mm is 6.4 mm high, ascenders and descenders included (round 8, #530)
